name: delay_ms
comment: r0 = milliseconds; called between AT1846S writes (ch. 11 §21)

name: lock
comment: mutex take before shared state (ch. 11 §13.1)

name: unlock
comment: mutex release (ch. 11 §13.1)

name: create_tasks
comment: ten OSTaskCreate calls (IRAM +0x3C390) (ch. 11 §13.2, §21.0)

name: at1846_apply_bw_profile
comment: writes 23 AT1846S registers: list in SRAM 0x18000808 (file +0x322E8), values from flash 0x03050608 + 46*r0 (file +0x36608); r0 = 0 12.5 kHz / 1 25 kHz bandwidth profile, not calibration (ch. 11 §21.2)

name: at1846_read_rssi
comment: reads AT1846S reg 0x1B, returns bits 15:8 (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_init
comment: AT1846S cold init: soft reset, clock, AGC page-1 table, calibration (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_tune
comment: per-channel apply: spur reg 0x05 by frequency, 0x29/0x2A frequency, DMR branch (0x58=0xBCFD, filters bypassed) or FM branch at 0x2FF2 (0x58=0x8405, filters on) (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_dmr_filters_bcfd
comment: movi r1,0xBCFD (imm16 LE at +2) for reg 0x58 in the DMR branch: voice HPF (bit 6), emphasis (bit 7), voice LPF, CTCSS filters bypassed (ch. 11 §21.3)

name: at1846_fm_filters_8405
comment: movi r1,0x8405 (imm16 LE at +2) for reg 0x58 in the FM branch: voice HPF, emphasis, voice LPF, CTCSS filters all on (ch. 11 §21.3)

name: at1846_set_squelch
comment: writes reg 0x49 (squelch close) from two level bytes (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_set_ctcss_dcs
comment: CTCSS/DCS set-up: regs 0x4A-0x4E, 0x3A, 0x59, 0x58 (0x8404/0x8405, bit 3 = CTCSS HPF enabled at 0x3332) (ch. 11 §21)

name: uart_put
comment: MMIO UART byte output 0x1409xxxx (ch. 11 §10.2)

name: rf_state_0_1
comment: role not read; called with 0/1 around AT1846S reg 0x30 changes at 0xB00C/0xB048 (ch. 11 §21)

name: apply_analog_config
comment: memcpy 0xB0 + MMIO 0x1100xxxx (ch. 11 §11.6)

name: uart_rx_task
comment: waits for 0x68; 0x20/0x0F discarded, 0x21 -> family_21, else phone_dispatch (ch. 11 §14.1)

name: checksum
comment: one's-complement BE-word checksum (ch. 11 §10.1)

name: uart_send
comment: lock, uart_put, unlock (ch. 11 §10.2)

name: family21_emit
comment: builds 68 21 <sub> frames (ch. 11 §14.3)

name: family21_dispatch
comment: 0x21 sub-command dispatcher, 35 entries via RAM table 0x030520D8 (ch. 11 §14.1)

name: set_tx_gain_reg44
comment: 1-byte body -> AT1846S reg 0x44 bits 11:8 (TX/mic gain), low byte forced 0xFF (ch. 11 §21; likely cmd 0x2A MIC)

name: checksum_wrap
comment: writes buf[4..5] (ch. 11 §10.1)

name: ack_empty
comment: empty-frame ACK, cmd echoed (ch. 11 §11.6)

name: reply_build
comment: (cmd, sr, body*, len) -> 68 cmd sr 00 ck ck len body 10 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd22_digital_unpack
comment: 163-byte digital channel body (ch. 11 §13.1)

name: cmd23_analog
comment: analog channel command, contains unpack 0x9A2C (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: analog_unpack
comment: 19-byte analog body unpack + ACK (ch. 11 §11.4)

name: analog_repack_sq
comment: sq -> body[10] as-is (ch. 11 §11.6)

name: status_query_bit5
comment: ACK with sr = bit 5 of 0x38908 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd24_query_digital
comment: reply 163 B from 0x38E4C (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd25_query_analog
comment: reply 19 B from 0x38C70 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd39_query_mix
comment: reply 169 B from 0x38AB0 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: cmd34_version_reply
comment: copies 17 B from 0x03052464 = flash 0x0301A000 + 0x38464, the image version string (pool word at 0xA9E8) and replies (ch. 11 §21.4)

name: cmd2b_caller_info
comment: 9-byte caller-info reply (ch. 11 §20)

name: phone_dispatch
comment: validate frame, switch(cmd-0x22) via RAM table 0x03052240 (ch. 11 §14.2)

name: at1846_rx_off
comment: clears reg 0x30 bits 5/6 then bit 2 (ch. 11 §21)

name: at1846_rx_on
comment: sets reg 0x30 bit 2 then bit 5 (ch. 11 §21)

name: memcpy
comment: dst r0, src r1, len r2 (ch. 11 §11.6)

name: ctcss_table
comment: 50 x LE16 centihertz, 67.00-254.10 Hz (ch. 11 §18)

name: version_string
comment: DMR003.UV4T.V022, NUL-terminated; read by 0x34 at flash 0x03052464 (ch. 11 §21.4)

name: OSTaskCreate
comment: IRAM 0x12F88 (flat call target 0xFCFF8F88, 58 callers) (ch. 11 §13.2, §21.0)

name: at1846_i2c_write
comment: IRAM 0x2B220 (flat call target 0xFD011220): I2C to 0xE2 (7-bit 0x71), [reg, hi, lo] (ch. 11 §21.1)

name: at1846_i2c_read
comment: IRAM 0x2B25C (flat call target 0xFD01125C): read reg r0 (ch. 11 §21.1)

name: tx_launch_action
comment: the stock key / unkey action behind cmd 0x26 LAUNCH: four bsr sites in its handler (0x92C8/0x92E0 launch=1 key, byte 0x38874 == / != 0; 0x92AA/0x92FA launch=2 unkey, r7 == / != 0). The R3a2+ stubs redirect those sites to on_key/on_unkey and call +0xE9C first (ch. 19 §23, results R3a2–R4o)

name: cmd26_launch_bsr_sites
comment: first of the four bsr +0xE9C sites inside the 0x26 LAUNCH handler (0x92AA, 0x92C8, 0x92E0, 0x92FA); patched to the stub by every R3a/R4 image

name: uart_status_sender
comment: sender woken by status_post; emits 68 36 <byte> (results R4k)

name: status_post
comment: r0 = status byte: stores it at RAM 0x38EF2, sets bit 0 of 0x38EF0, wakes uart_status_sender +0x7BC0; 3 = SEND_START, 4 = SEND_STOP (results R4k)

name: txram_refill_task
comment: task entry that clears SYS_INTERP_LIST bit 15 (the TX-RAM half-empty interrupt) and copies no samples; left unpatched (results R4c)

name: txram_wake_site_a
comment: per-wake call in the service wake, byte 0 of 0x34808 == 0; R4d+ hook point on_wake_disp (dispatches on to 0x03032B70)

name: txram_wake_site_b
comment: per-wake call in the service wake, byte 0 of 0x34808 != 0; R4d+ hook point on_wake_skip

name: data_table_tail
comment: zeros after a run of 0x01 inside a data table: NOT free, code placed here did not boot (results R4l)

name: phone_dispatch_table
comment: word table indexed cmd − 0x22 (XIP 0x03052240, the table phone_dispatch reads); slot +0x382B8 = cmd 0x40 (results R4l–R4o)

name: cmd40_factory_empty
comment: factory handler for cmd 0x40: pop r4-r8, r15 only; a free command slot (results R4l)

name: cmd3d_handler
comment: real factory handler for cmd 0x3D (index 27); do not replace (results R4l)

name: fm_keyup
comment: FM key-up (IRAM-copied; runs during module boot too): RF_MODE store at 0x3EDDA (0x10E0), tx_voice_source cleared at 0x3EDF8 (ch. 19 §21–§23)

name: fm_unkey_path
comment: unkey path that follows the boot-time key-up (ch. 19 §23)

name: zero_tail
comment: 1,788 B of zero padding in the factory image, XIP 0x03074EFC, not IRAM-copied: where R4m+ stubs link (ch. 19 §1, §22). Occupied after FW25

name: fw25_free_tail
comment: DMR003.FW25.V022 length 0x5C6FC; extension ends at 0x5C464; 664 B free through 0x5C6FB. FW26 links here (232 B, end 0x5C54C)

name: fw27_apply5
comment: op 6 variant trampoline. The live compares are at 0x5B2C8 (apply, cmpnei r1,4) and 0x5B2A8 (restore, cmpnei r1,3), in the handler at 0x5B240. Variant 4 returns to 0x030752CC and variant 3 to 0x030752AC. Variant 5 calls mode 5 at file 0x5BCD6 and the restore at 0x5BD42. rest5 is at 0x5C562. Ends 0x5C590; bytes after that through 0x5C6FB stay zero

name: fw27_stub
comment: opcode 13 playback reclaimed: fw23_play started here and opcode 14 starts at 0x5C098. FW27 links here (1008 B, end 0x5C094). Opcode 12 ends at 0x5BCA2 and is kept

name: fw27_pend
comment: replaces the UART pend bsr at 0x7C56. Flag 0 calls the flash pend at file 0x2B0C. Flag 1 asks for a short wait and counts down 0x4B36C

name: fw27_op13_reject
comment: opcode 13 branches to the sr=1 return at 0x5B876. The playback is not called

name: op5_sendh
comment: op 5's copy-and-send. Reply body: sample bytes at 0..511, sequence byte at 512 (slot 0..5), half id at 513 (0 = RAM 0x160004E0, 1 = 0x160006E0)

name: fw26_gate
comment: cmd 0x40 op 15. Replaces cmphsi r3,15 / bt .Lpass at 0x5B7DE. Body [15, v], v 0 or 1; reply is one byte, the flag now in force. Any other v returns sr 1 and leaves the flag

name: fw26_admit
comment: Patch A. Gates 0xC1BA and 0xC244 call this instead of 0x2404. Returns the getter, or 1 when that is 0 and the flag at 0x4B364 is 1

name: fw26_finish
comment: Patch D. 0xA890 calls this instead of reply_build. Flag off keeps the 9-byte body. Flag on appends CC (RX_TYPE_INFO >> 4) & 15 and slot (>> 19) & 1

name: fw26_ccbit
comment: Patch B. Replaces andi r2,15 at 0x17E26. The st.w at 0x17E2A stays. Flag on sets bit 8 (cc_opt) before that store

name: fw26_flag
comment: NOT a file offset: IRAM address of the promiscuous flag. BSS zeroed from 0x31AF4 to 0x4DAB0, in the gap after the tone queue at 0x4B360 and before the factory name at 0x4B398
